description: Psychological risk assessments (GBU Psyche) via Safe Mind: surveys, departments, analytics.

tool_signatures.name: safe_mind_create_department
tool_signatures.description: Create one department/area (Tätigkeitsbereich) of the company and return its id and name. Idempotent: if an area with exactly this name exists, that one is returned and nothing is duplicated. Not needed before safe_mind_create_survey, which creates missing areas by name itself. Areas cannot be renamed or deleted through the API. ${AUTH_NOTE}

tool_signatures.name: safe_mind_create_location
tool_signatures.description: Create one location (Standort) of the company and return its id and name. Use it for companies with several sites whose results should be compared; single-site companies do not need locations. Idempotent: if a location with exactly this name exists, that one is returned and nothing is duplicated. Not needed before safe_mind_create_survey, which creates missing locations by name itself. Locations cannot be renamed or deleted through the API. ${AUTH_NOTE}

tool_signatures.name: safe_mind_create_survey
tool_signatures.description: Create a survey draft for the psychological risk assessment and return its id, status

tool_signatures.name: safe_mind_get_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Aggregated results of one survey: respondent count, anonymity threshold and the average score per category (scale -1 to +1, higher is better; the Safe Mind app shows the same values times 10). With groupBy the averages are split by department, location, age group or gender. Groups below the anonymity threshold are never returned, only counted in suppressedGroupCount, and individual answers are never exposed. resultsAvailable is false until the survey is paid. Read-only. ${AUTH_NOTE}

surveyId.description: Survey id (UUID) as returned by safe_mind_list_surveys or safe_mind_create_survey.

groupBy.description: Optional split of the results. Omit for the overall result of the whole survey.

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Optional split of the results. Omit for the overall result of the whole survey.

parameters.name: surveyId
parameters.description: Survey id (UUID) as returned by safe_mind_list_surveys or safe_mind_create_survey.

tool_signatures.name: safe_mind_get_api_key
tool_signatures.description: Log in with email and password of a verified Safe Mind account and create an API key. Call this before any company, survey or analytics tool unless SAFE_MIND_API_KEY is already set. The key is kept in memory for this session only and also returned, so the user can store it as SAFE_MIND_API_KEY for later sessions. Fails if the email is not verified yet (use safe_mind_verify_email) or the credentials are wrong.

email.description: Email address of the verified Safe Mind account.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address of the verified Safe Mind account.

tool_signatures.name: safe_mind_get_survey
tool_signatures.description: Show one survey of the company: title, status (draft, active, closed, archived), start and end date, participant limit, anonymity threshold, the participation link for employees and the edit link for the account owner. Read-only. Use it to check a single survey or fetch its links; for an overview of all surveys use safe_mind_list_surveys, for results use safe_mind_get_analytics. Returns a not-found error for ids that do not exist or belong to another company. ${AUTH_NOTE}

surveyId.description: Survey id (UUID) as returned by safe_mind_list_surveys or safe_mind_create_survey.

parameters.name: surveyId
parameters.description: Survey id (UUID) as returned by safe_mind_list_surveys or safe_mind_create_survey.

tool_signatures.name: safe_mind_list_departments
tool_signatures.description: List the departments/areas (Tätigkeitsbereiche) of the company as id and name. Surveys segment results by these areas. Read-only. Call it before safe_mind_create_department or safe_mind_create_survey to reuse existing names exactly. ${AUTH_NOTE}

tool_signatures.name: safe_mind_list_locations
tool_signatures.description: List the locations (Standorte) of the company as id and name. Locations are an optional second segmentation next to departments, useful for companies with several sites. Read-only. Call it before safe_mind_create_location to reuse existing names exactly. ${AUTH_NOTE}

tool_signatures.name: safe_mind_list_surveys
tool_signatures.description: List all surveys of the company, newest first, each with id, title, status (draft, active, closed, archived), start and end date, participant limit, anonymity threshold, participation link and edit link. Read-only. Use it to find the surveyId needed by safe_mind_get_survey and safe_mind_get_analytics. ${AUTH_NOTE}

tool_signatures.name: safe_mind_me
tool_signatures.description: Show who is connected: name and email of the account and the company (id, name, employee count) that all other tools act on. Use it to check the API key works or to confirm the company before creating anything. Read-only. ${AUTH_NOTE}

tool_signatures.name: safe_mind_register
tool_signatures.description: Create a new Safe Mind account together with its company. Safe Mind runs the legally required psychological risk assessment (Gefährdungsbeurteilung psychischer Belastung, GBU Psyche) for German companies. Use this only when the user has no account yet; for an existing account go straight to safe_mind_get_api_key. No API key needed. Sends a 6-digit verification code to the email address and returns a confirmation message; the account is usable after safe_mind_verify_email. For privacy the answer is the same whether or not the address is already registered. Disposable (throwaway) email addresses are rejected with an error.

email.description: Work email address of the person creating the account; receives the verification code.

password.description: Account password: at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.

firstName.description: First name of the account owner.

lastName.description: Last name of the account owner.

employeeCount.description: Number of employees of the company; used for pricing and the survey participant limit.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Work email address of the person creating the account; receives the verification code.

parameters.name: employeeCount
parameters.description: Number of employees of the company; used for pricing and the survey participant limit.

parameters.name: firstName
parameters.description: First name of the account owner.

parameters.name: lastName
parameters.description: Last name of the account owner.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Account password: at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.

tool_signatures.name: safe_mind_verify_email
tool_signatures.description: Confirm a newly registered account with the 6-digit code from the verification email sent by safe_mind_register. No API key needed. Returns a confirmation message; afterwards call safe_mind_get_api_key. A wrong or expired code returns an error without revealing whether the account exists.

email.description: The email address used in safe_mind_register.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email address used in safe_mind_register.
